title: SAML 2.0 automated metadata heuristics + operator playbook for validation failures
creator: Alex Morgan
description:
Summary:
We need an automated metadata heuristic layer and a concrete operator playbook to improve SAML 2.0 setup wizard reliability. Current customer onboarding failures cluster around subtle metadata deviations (entityID prefixes, non-standard ACS URL encodings, certificate whitespace, and alternate entity descriptors). This ticket implements: (1) metadata normalization heuristics run during Exchange step; (2) detailed validation with graded error codes; (3) machine-suggested fixes surfaced in the wizard; (4) audit-log hooks for every exchange attempt; and (5) an operator playbook for remediation and rollback when heuristic fixes are insufficient.

Goals:
- Reduce SAML onboarding failures by 60% for new customers within 2 sprints.
- Provide deterministic, auditable validation decisions so support can triage in <30 min.
- Ensure all automated fixes are reversible and logged for compliance.

Scope and deliverables:
- Heuristics engine that canonicalizes common metadata problems (entityID normalization, trailing slash handling, URL percent-decoding for ACS/Logout, X509 cert whitespace/PEM header/footer normalization).
- Validation module that produces structured, human-readable findings with severity levels (info/warning/error) and remediation suggestions (manual steps + one-click fixes).
- Wizard UI changes to show proposed fixes and require explicit consent before applying.
- Audit log entries for exchange attempts containing outcome, applied heuristics, user ID, and obfuscated certificate fingerprints. Logs shipped to the existing audit pipeline (Splunk/CloudWatch).
- Operator playbook document (embedded link) detailing commands, dashboard queries, and escalation paths for failure modes.

Implementation notes / trade-offs:
- Heuristics are intentionally conservative: prefer suggestion over automatic mutation for high-risk fields (certificate content, entity descriptors). We will auto-normalize low-risk fields (trailing slash, percent-encoding) but show the change in the UI and record in the audit log.
- Performance: validation runs are cheap (XML parse + XSD + small heuristics) and should not add more than 150ms p95 to the wizard flow; heavy verification (full signature verification against remote metadata URLs) will run asynchronously with progress indicators.
- Compatibility: maintain backwards compatibility with existing SAML connectors; expose a versioned metadata schema so we can roll out heuristics incrementally.

Acceptance criteria:
- The wizard displays a detailed validation report for every metadata exchange showing at least 3 actionable remediation suggestions when issues are detected.
- Automated normalization applied only to low-risk fields by default; any certificate normalization requires explicit consent.
- All exchange attempts produce an audit-log entry that includes outcome = {success|partial_fix|error}, heuristics_applied = [list], and operator_notes = "" (nullable).
- Unit and integration tests covering 25+ synthetic metadata samples representing common failure patterns.
- Playbook doc added to Confluence and linked from the wizard "Need help?" modal.

Testing plan:
- Create a corpus of 30 real-world metadata samples collected from support cases (sanitized) representing: missing ACS, odd entityID encodings, multi-encoded URLs, certificate header/footer problems, and metadata with embedded comments.
- End-to-end tests: wizard roundtrip using staging IdPs (Okta, Azure AD, OneLogin) + simulated malformed metadata responses.
- Load test wizard flow at 200 concurrent exchanges to validate no increased error rate under load.

Rollout and monitoring:
- Feature flag for heuristics and structured validation (default off for 1 week, then opt-in for support-triaged customers, then global).
- Dashboards: SSO Onboarding success rate, validation errors by type, time-to-fix, and audit-log volume. Alerts if onboarding success rate drops >5% post-release.

Operator playbook (high level):
1) Identify exchange ID from customer support ticket.
2) Query audit log: "sso.exchange.outcome=partial_fix AND exchange_id=<id>".
3) Review heuristics_applied array; if cert-related, do not re-run auto-fix; follow manual cert remediation steps.
4) If heuristics produce ambiguous entityIDs, run the normalization simulator (internal CLI) to preview impact.
5) Escalate to security on "error" outcomes with certificate or signature failures.

Links / artifacts:
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1827 (validation engine)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/940 (wizard UI)
- Design spec: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2B3_example_design
- Playbook (draft): https://confluence.redwood.com/display/SEC/SAML+Exchange+Playbook
- Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/SSO/onboarding-success-rate

Notes on compliance and auditability:
- All certificate fingerprints logged are SHA256 hex but stored obfuscated in public views. Full fingerprints only available to security analysts with audit role.
- Playbook contains steps to create an auditable ticket for any manual certificate change.

Open questions:
- Do we allow configurable tenant-level default to auto-apply low-risk fixes? (ask PM)
- Do we surface heuristics_applied to customers in provisioning emails? (privacy consideration)
acceptance_criteria: Wizard shows structured validation report with severity and suggestions
Low-risk fields auto-normalized; cert changes require consent
Audit logs produced for every exchange with heuristics_applied array
Corpus of 25+ test metadata samples covered by CI
Operator playbook published and linked from wizard
comments: 2025-03-01 - Alex Morgan: Initial ticket created after investigating three onboarding incidents in Feb. Filed corpus collection task ENG-86001.
2025-03-03 - Priya Patel: Reviewed and added UX requirement to require explicit consent for cert normalization. Marked security_review_required.
2025-03-05 - Diego Ramirez: Spike shows normalization of percent-encoded ACS reduces failures in staging by ~48%. Will add additional unit tests for multi-encoded URLs.
2025-03-07 - Priya Patel: Merged initial validation engine PR to staging. Need operator playbook review from SRE and Security before can enable feature flag.
2025-03-07 - Security Team (via comment): Please ensure cert fingerprint obfuscation is implemented before any logs are viewable by non-security roles.
decision_log: 2025-03-02: Decided to auto-normalize trailing slashes and percent-encoding but not certificates without consent.
2025-03-04: Chose to emit structured validation findings rather than freeform error text for easier automation downstream.
2025-03-06: Feature behind flag; staged rollout plan agreed with PM and SRE.
rollback_plan: If rollout causes regressions: (1) Turn off heuristics feature flag globally; (2) Re-run failed exchanges in diagnostic mode and attach results to customer ticket; (3) Revert console PRs via standard revert PR flow; (4) Notify impacted customers and open postmortem if onboarding success drops >5%.
test_plan: Unit tests for each heuristic + integration tests against staging IdPs. Add corpus-based CI job to validate 30 samples on every commit to platform validation engine. Load-test wizard flow at target concurrency. Add synthetic monitoring that performs end-to-end SSO setup nightly.
operator_notes: Audit log query: sso.exchange.outcome:<value> AND exchange_id:<id>
For cert issues: escalate to security@redwood.com with exchange_id and obfuscated_fingerprint
